mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dev_program_params (project_id, file_path, engine, datasources, jar_dependency_catalogs, run_params, compute_resources, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{entity.projectId}, #{entity.filePath}, #{entity.engine}, #{entity.datasources}, #{entity.jarDependencyCatalogs}, #{entity.runParams}, #{entity.computeResources}, #{entity.remark}, NOW(), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (project_id, file_path) DO UPDATE SET engine = EXCLUDED.engine, datasources = EXCLUDED.datasources, jar_dependency_catalogs = EXCLUDED.jar_dependency_catalogs, run_params = EXCLUDED.run_params, compute_resources = EXCLUDED.compute_resources, remark = EXCLUDED.remark, update_time = NOW()
